description: Expo CLI - Tools to develop, build, and deploy Expo / React Native apps
Usually invoked via npx expo or bunx expo

next.name: config
tip: Show the project config

option.name: --full
tip: Include all project config data

option.name: --json
tip: Output in JSON format

option.name: --type
tip: Type of config to show

next.name: customize
tip: Generate static project files (metro.config.js, babel.config.js, etc.)

next.name: export
tip: Export the static files of the app for hosting it on a web server

option.name: --api-only
tip: Skip exporting static HTML files and only export API routes for web

option.name: --clear
tip: Clear the bundler cache

option.name: --dev
tip: Configure static files for developing locally using a non-https server

option.name: --dump-assetmap
tip: Emit an asset map for further processing

option.name: --max-workers
tip: Maximum number of tasks to allow the bundler to spawn

option.name: --no-bytecode
tip: Prevent generating Hermes bytecode

option.name: --no-minify
tip: Prevent minifying source

option.name: --output-dir
tip: Directory to export the static files to. Default: dist

option.name: --platform
tip: Platform to export. Default: all

option.name: --source-maps
tip: Emit JavaScript source maps. Default: false

next.name: install
tip: Install a module or other package to a project

option.name: --bun
tip: Use bun to install dependencies. Default when bun.lock or bun.lockb exists

option.name: --check
tip: Check which installed packages need to be updated

option.name: --dev
tip: Save the dependencies as devDependencies

option.name: --fix
tip: Automatically update any invalid package versions

option.name: --json
tip: Output dependency information in JSON format with --check flag

option.name: --npm
tip: Use npm to install dependencies. Default when package-lock.json exists

option.name: --pnpm
tip: Use pnpm to install dependencies. Default when pnpm-lock.yaml exists

option.name: --yarn
tip: Use Yarn to install dependencies. Default when yarn.lock exists

next.name: login
tip: Log in to an Expo account

option.name: --browser
tip: Log in with a browser

option.name: --otp
tip: One-time password from your 2FA device

option.name: --password
tip: Password ("-" for stdin)

option.name: --sso
tip: Log in with SSO

option.name: --username
tip: Username

next.name: logout
tip: Log out of an Expo account

next.name: prebuild
tip: Create native iOS and Android project files for building natively

option.name: --bun
tip: Use bun to install dependencies. Default when bun.lock or bun.lockb exists

option.name: --clean
tip: Delete the native folders and regenerate them before applying changes

option.name: --no-install
tip: Skip installing npm packages and CocoaPods

option.name: --npm
tip: Use npm to install dependencies. Default when package-lock.json exists

option.name: --platform
tip: Platforms to sync. Default: all

option.name: --pnpm
tip: Use pnpm to install dependencies. Default when pnpm-lock.yaml exists

option.name: --skip-dependency-update
tip: Preserves versions of listed packages in package.json (comma separated list)

option.name: --template
tip: Project template to clone from. File path pointing to a local tar file, npm package or a github repo

option.name: --yarn
tip: Use Yarn to install dependencies. Default when yarn.lock exists

next.name: register
tip: Sign up for a new Expo account

option.name: --app-id
tip: Custom Android application ID to launch

option.name: --binary
tip: Path to existing .apk or .aab to install

option.name: --device
tip: Device name to run the app on

option.name: --no-build-cache
tip: Clear the native build cache

option.name: --no-bundler
tip: Skip starting the bundler

option.name: --no-install
tip: Skip installing dependencies

option.name: --port
tip: Port to start the dev server on. Default: 8081

option.name: --variant

tip: Run the iOS app binary locally

option.name: --binary
tip: Path to existing .app or .ipa to install

option.name: --configuration
tip: Xcode configuration to use. Debug or Release. Default: Debug

option.name: --device
tip: Device name, UDID, or "generic" for build-only

option.name: --no-build-cache
tip: Clear the native derived data before building

option.name: --no-bundler
tip: Skip starting the Metro bundler

option.name: --no-install
tip: Skip installing dependencies

option.name: --output
tip: Directory to output the built app binary

option.name: --port
tip: Port to start the Metro bundler on. Default: 8081

option.name: --scheme
tip: Scheme to build

next.name: serve
tip: Host the production server locally

option.name: --port
tip: Port to host the server on

tip: Start a local dev server for the app

option.name: --android
tip: Open on a connected Android device

option.name: --clear
tip: Clear the bundler cache

option.name: --dev-client
tip: Launch in a custom native app

option.name: --go
tip: Launch in Expo Go

option.name: --host
tip: Dev server hosting type. Default: lan

option.name: --https
tip: Start the dev server with https protocol. Deprecated in favor of --tunnel

option.name: --ios
tip: Open in an iOS simulator

tip: Same as --host lan

option.name: --localhost
tip: Same as --host localhost

option.name: --max-workers
tip: Maximum number of tasks to allow Metro to spawn

option.name: --minify
tip: Minify JavaScript

option.name: --no-dev
tip: Bundle in production mode

option.name: --offline
tip: Skip network requests and use anonymous manifest signatures

option.name: --port
tip: Port to start the dev server on (does not apply to web or tunnel). Default: 8081

option.name: --private-key-path
tip: Path to private key for code signing. Default: "private-key.pem" in the same directory as the certificate specified by the expo-updates configuration in app.json

option.name: --scheme
tip: Custom URI protocol to use when launching an app

option.name: --tunnel
tip: Same as --host tunnel

option.name: --web
tip: Open in a web browser

tip: Show the currently authenticated username
